requirements.text: The system must use no more than 3% of host CPU and 1% of network bandwidth, and ensure secure communication.

requirements.quote: Head End System (HES): The main objective of HES is to acquire meter data automatically avoiding any human intervention and monitor parameters acquired from meters. HES also shall serve as the control and monitoring hub for sending commands to end points individually/ in defined groups or across the entire network. The HES shall provide the means to monitor the network's status from end-to-end and the status of each and every device (signal strength, dynamic status of links with colour-codes, throughput, available bandwidth etc.) in the network in real-time, and provide performance and activity statistics.
requirements.text: The HES must acquire meter data automatically, monitor network and device status, and provide real-time performance statistics.

requirements.quote: Meter Data Management System (MDM): The Meter Data Management System shall support storage, archiving, retrieval & analysis of meter data and various other MIS along with validation & verification algorithms. It shall act as a central data repository with interactive dashboard. MDM shall have capability to import raw or validated data in defined formats and export the processed and validated data to various other systems sources and services in the agreed format. It shall provide validated data for upstream systems such as billing, consumer Information system, customer care, analytics, reporting, Network planning & analysis, load analysis/forecasting, Peak Load Management, Outage management etc.
requirements.text: The MDM must manage meter data storage, analysis, and integration with other systems, providing validated data for various applications.

requirements.quote: The scope of the AMI System Integrator includes Site survey, planning, design, engineering, proof of concept, supply, delivery at site, storage, installation, system integration, configuration, testing, commissioning, demonstration for acceptance, training, warranty /AMC support, documentation and any other activity as per customer requirements.
requirements.text: The AMI System Integrator must handle all project phases from planning to support and documentation.

requirements.quote: System Integrator shall install all the supplied meters at the specified locations and establish the required communication network and integration with backend system.
requirements.text: The System Integrator must install meters and establish communication networks integrated with backend systems.

requirements.quote: System Integrator should have the capability to access the real time data and provide all information on a single console in an integrated manner to remotely control the entire network and increase operational efficiency.
requirements.text: The System Integrator must provide real-time data access and control via a single integrated console.

requirements.quote: The AMI System Integrator should establish network platform that can support all the applications like HES, MDMS etc over the Communication network.
requirements.text: The System Integrator must establish a network platform supporting HES, MDMS, and other applications.

requirements.quote: Deployment and management of all the application on Data center/Cloud including HES and MDMS depending on the requirements.
requirements.text: The System Integrator must deploy and manage applications on Data Center/Cloud, including HES and MDMS.

requirements.quote: Integration with existing legacy system of the customer including metering, billing and collection as required by customer.
requirements.text: The System Integrator must integrate with the customer's existing legacy systems, including metering, billing, and collection.
